Blair Vision settings

For practice quizzes, studying, accessibility and your own test pages. Blair Vision only displays a suggested option; it never clicks or submits anything. Do not use it on proctored or graded exams.

Provider

Local testing without a key: run npm run demo, pick “TypeSafe”, set the endpoint to http://localhost:8787/v1/systemone and any key (e.g. mock).

Behaviour

Blocked domains

Blair Vision refuses to run on these sites (and their subdomains).
